title: Dashboard, bulk editor and stop sales
text: Figures across every broker, changing many brokers at once, and closing cars for some dates.

title: Dashboard: requests, bookings, revenue, errors and alerts across every broker, for the period you choose.
Per-broker figures show who sells most and who has problems; click a broker to open it.
Bulk editor: change rates, extras, terms and policies for several brokers at once, with a preview before anything is saved.
Stop sales: close a car or a car group for some dates, for every broker or only chosen ones.
text: Example: all SUVs closed over the Eid holiday for walk-in customers. Brokers stop seeing them at once.
